defs.def: something that you can hear 声音；响声

ex.s: By listening for sounds.
ex.t: 通过倾听声音。

ex.s: Human speech contains more than 2,000 different sounds, from the common “m” and “a” to the rare clicks of some southern African languages.
ex.t: 人类语言包含2000多种不同的声音，从常见的"m"和"a"到某些南部非洲语言中罕见的咔嗒音。

ex.s: But why are certain sounds more common than others?
ex.t: 但为什么某些声音比其他声音更常见呢？

ex.s: Walking through the streets of Brooklyn today, I am no longer confused by this city’s sounds and smells.
ex.t: 今天走在布鲁克林的街道上，我不再对这个城市的声音和气味感到困惑。

ex.s: These sounds are still not found in the languages of many hunter-gatherer people today.
ex.t: 这些声音在今天许多狩猎采集民族的语言中仍然不存在。

ex.s: Nature seems to unfold to people who watch and wait． Next time you take a walk， no matter where it is， take in all the sights， sounds and sensations． Wander in this frame of mind and you will open a new dimension to your life．
ex.t: 大自然似乎向那些观察和等待的人展开。下次你散步时，无论在哪里，都要领略所有的景色、声音和感觉。带着这种心态闲逛，你会为生活打开一个新的维度。

ex.s: Sound can be used as a weapon.
ex.t: 声音可以用作武器。

ex.s: In the past, sound engineers worked in the back rooms of recording studios, but many of today's sound professionals are sharing their knowledge and experience with professionals in other fields to create new products based on the phenomenon we call sound.
ex.t: 过去，音响工程师在录音棚的后室工作，但如今许多声音专业人士正与其他领域的专业人士分享知识和经验，以基于我们所谓的声音现象创造新产品。

ex.s: A spotlight lights up only one section of a stage; similarly,"spotsound" creates a circle of sound in on targeted area.
ex.t: 聚光灯只照亮舞台上的一个区域；类似地，“spotsound”在目标区域制造一个声音圈。

ex.s: remove the sound of commercials
ex.t: 去除广告的声音。

ex.s: block the incoming sound waves
ex.t: 消除商业广告的声音

ex.s: For people, who are interested in sound, the field of sound technology is definitely making noise.
ex.t: 对于对声音感兴趣的人，声音技术领域确实在引起关注。

ex.s: First they collected sound data from 67 nests in four sites in Queensland before and after hatching.
ex.t: 首先，他们在孵化前后从昆士兰州四个地点的67个巢穴收集声音数据。

ex.s: Analyses of a language database also confirmed that there was a global change in the sound of world languages after the Neolithic age, with the use of “f” and “v” increasing remarkably during the last few thousand years.
ex.t: 对一个语言数据库的分析也证实，新石器时代之后世界语言的声音发生了全球性的变化，"f"和"v"的使用在近几千年显著增加。

ex.s: For those who hunger for some peace and quiet, sound can now create silence.
ex.t: 对于那些渴望安宁与清静的人来说，声音现在可以创造寂静。

ex.s: Thanks to the Silence Machine, a British invention, you can get rid of the sound without upsetting the boy or his parents.
ex.t: 多亏了静音机这一英国发明，你可以在不惹恼男孩或他父母的情况下摆脱这种声音。

ex.s: How professionals invented sound products.
ex.t: 专业人士如何发明声音产品。

ex.s: Directed sound is also beginning to appear in shopping centers and even at homes.
ex.t: 定向声音也开始出现在购物中心甚至家庭中。

ex.s: Inventions in the field of sound technology.
ex.t: 声音技术领域的发明。

ex.s: Female Australian superb fairy wrens were found to repeat one sound over and over again while hatching their eggs.
ex.t: 人们发现，雌性澳大利亚壮丽细尾鹩莺在孵蛋时会一遍又一遍地重复同一个声音。

ex.s: Well, it functions by analyzing the waves of the incoming sound and creating a second set of outgoing waves.
ex.t: 它通过分析传入声波的波形，并产生第二组传出声波来工作。

ex.s: Before birth, babies can tell the difference between loud sounds and voices.
ex.t: 但规模本身并不是罪过。

ex.s: It made the sweetest sound I'd ever heard!My heart was dancing along with its flowing tune.
ex.t: 它发出了我听到过的最悦耳的声音！我的心随着它流畅的旋律翩翩起舞。

ex.s: The sound of the violin.
ex.t: 寻求UCLA工作人员的帮助。

ex.s: You could still hear the operatic sounds it was making underwater.”
ex.t: 你还能听到它在水下发出的歌剧般的声音。"

ex.s: It produces a deafening sound so painful that it temporarily disables a person.
ex.t: 它发出震耳欲聋、令人剧痛的声音，会暂时使一个人丧失能力。

ex.s: When the eggs were hatched, the baby birds made the similar chirp to their mothers—a sound that served as their regular ＂feed me!＂ call.
ex.t: 蛋孵化后，幼鸟会发出与母亲相似的声音——一种作为它们常规“喂我！”叫声的声音。

defs.def: continuous rapid movements (called vibrations ) that travel through air or water and can be heard when they reach a person's or an animal's ear 声；声响

ex.s: stop unwanted sound from affecting you
ex.t: 阻挡传入的声波

ex.s: The growing interest in the study of sound.
ex.t: 对声学研究日益增长的兴趣。

defs.def: what you can hear coming from a television, radio, etc., or as part of a film/movie 声音；音响

ex.s: But what they liked, they couldn’t afford on his sound engineer’s salary and what they could, they didn’t like.
ex.t: 但他们喜欢的，靠他音响工程师的工资买不起；而买得起的，他们又不喜欢。

ex.s: How sound engineers work in their studios.
ex.t: 对声音研究的兴趣日益增长。

defs.def: the effect that is produced by the music of a particular singer or group of musicians 嗓音；音乐风格

ex.s: His job is to sit beside the pianist and turn the pages of the score so the musicians don’t have to break the flow of sound by doing it themselves.
ex.t: 他的工作是坐在钢琴家旁边翻乐谱，这样音乐家就不必自己翻谱而打断音乐的流畅性。

defs.def: the idea or impression that you get of sb/sth from what sb says or what you read 印象；感觉
a narrow passage of water that joins two larger areas of water 常用于地名
to give a particular impression when heard or read about 听起来好像；让人听着好像

ex.s: This isn’t as hard as it    62   (sound), and it is far better than any other method because you improve your vocabulary while    63   (read) an interesting piece of literature.
ex.t: 这并不像它___62___（听起来）那么难，而且远比任何其他方法好，因为你在___63___（阅读）一篇有趣的文学作品时提高了词汇量。

ex.s: The voices themselves sounded really unique-some of the female voices were so high that I was sure they could break glass!
ex.t: 声音本身听起来非常独特 一些女性的声音是如此之高 我敢肯定，他们可以打破玻璃！

ex.s: This means. for example，that a scammer could call you from what looks to be a familiar number and talk to you using a voice that sounds exactly like your bank teller 's，ricking you into "confirming " your address，mother's name，and card number.
ex.t: 这意味着，比如说，一个骗子可以给你打电话 从一个看起来熟悉的号码 并用一个声音和你说话 听起来就像你的银行出纳的，让你"确认"你的地址，母亲的名字，和卡片号码。

ex.s: The man’s words sounded pretty convincing.
ex.t: 所有营员需自带午餐和零食。

ex.s: They looked and sounded so free.
ex.t: 他们看起来和听起来都那么自由自在。

ex.s: Sounds harmless, right?
ex.t: 听起来无害，对吧？

ex.s: “It sounds crazy to talk about guilt-free fur-unless you understand that the nutria are destroying vast wetlands every year”, says Cree McCree, project director of Righteous Fur.
ex.t: “谈论没有愧疚感的毛皮听起来很疯狂——除非你明白海狸鼠每年都在摧毁大片的湿地，”Righteous Fur项目总监克里·麦克里说。

ex.s: A local farmer told them the dog sounded like one   50   as lost in the local paper.
ex.t: 一位当地农夫告诉他们，这只狗听起来像是当地报纸上报道过____50____丢失的那只。

ex.s: Turning soil, pulling weeds, and harvesting cabbage sound like tough work for middle and high school kids.
ex.t: 翻土、拔草和收卷心菜，对中学生和高中生来说听起来像是艰苦的劳动。

ex.s: How does Robert sound when speaking of his being a writer?
ex.t: 罗伯特谈到自己是一名作家时听起来怎样？

ex.s: How does Robert sound when speaking of his being a writer?
ex.t: 罗伯特谈到自己是一名作家时听起来怎样？

ex.s: How does Sara sound?
ex.t: 萨拉听起来怎么样？

ex.s: How does the woman sound?
ex.t: 这位女士听起来怎么样？

ex.s: How does Laura sound at the beginning of the conversation?
ex.t: Laura在对话开始时听起来怎样？

ex.s: How does the man sound?
ex.t: 男士听起来怎么样？

ex.s: Fewer emissions and cheaper travel sound pretty appealing.
ex.t: 更少的排放和更便宜的旅行听起来相当有吸引力。

ex.s: If you’re tired out by Friday night, sleeping in on Saturday could sound wonderful.
ex.t: 如果周五晚上你已经累了，周六睡个懒觉听起来会很美妙。

ex.s: Why does the man sound surprised?
ex.t: 为什么这位男士听起来很惊讶？

ex.s: The numbers might sound small, but they are the leading edge of a dangerous trend.
ex.t: 这些数字听起来可能很小，但它们是一种危险趋势的前沿。

ex.s: Sounds too good to be true?
ex.t: 听起来太好 不是真的？

ex.s: It might sound like one long, expensive   42  , but the couple has an unusual way to make their travel   43  .
ex.t: 这听起来像是一次漫长而昂贵的   42  ，但这夫妇有一种不同寻常的方式来使他们的旅行   43  。

ex.s: Rather than setting plans in stone, I’ve learned that sometimes I need to take the opportunities that are offered, even if they don’t sound perfect at the time, and make the most of them.
ex.t: 与其把计划定死，我学到了有时候我需要抓住提供的机会，即使当时听起来并不完美，并且充分利用它们。

ex.s: We figured that in twenty years each of us ought to have our destiny worked out and our fortunes made, whatever they were going to be.”“It sounds pretty interesting,” said the policeman.
ex.t: 我们想，二十年后，我们每个人都应该已经确定了自己的命运，并且发了财，不管结果会是什么。＂＂听起来挺有意思的，＂警察说。

ex.s: The question,“What do elephants and fish have in common?" may sound strange but researchers have found that they both have a feature not observed in any other creature.
ex.t: "大象和鱼有什么共同点？"这个问题听起来可能很奇怪，但研究人员发现它们都有一个在其他生物身上没有观察到的特征。

ex.s: For instance, if an object’s name was meant to sound genderless, like Miuu, participants would still assign a gender to it — they would assume Miuu was a “he” or “she.”
ex.t: 例如，如果一个物体的名字本意是无性别的，比如Miuu，参与者仍会给它赋予性别——他们会假定Miuu是“他”或“她”。

ex.s: How does the author sound in the last paragraph?
ex.t: 在最后一段中作者的语气是怎样的？

defs.def: giving the impression of having a particular sound 构成形容词

ex.s: ideal sound effects on the theater stage
ex.t: 剧院舞台上的理想音效。

defs.def: to produce a sound; to make sth such as a musical instrument produce a sound （使）发出声音，响

ex.s: She never minded the alarm clock sounding at 4 am or questioned my expenses on running.
ex.t: 她从不介意凌晨4点的闹钟响起，也不质疑我在跑步上的开销。

defs.def: to give a signal such as a warning by making a sound 鸣警报；拉响警报；发出警报

ex.s: Hundreds of scientists, writers and academics sounded a warning to humanity in an open letter published last December: Policymakers and the rest of us must engage openly with the risk of global collapse.
ex.t: 数百名科学家、作家和学者去年12月在发表的一封公开信中向人类发出警告：政策制定者和我们所有人都必须公开面对全球崩溃的风险。

ex.s: A ground-breaking, five-year study shows that diet-related changes in human bite led to new speech sounds that are now found in half the world’s languages.
ex.t: 一项开创性的五年研究表明，与人类咬合相关的饮食变化导致了新的语音，如今这些语音存在于世界上一半的语言中。

ex.s: I must have always known reading was very important because the first memories I have as a child deal with books． There was not one night that I don't remember mom reading me a storybook by my bedside． I was extremely inspired by the elegant way the words sounded．
ex.t: 我一定一直都知道阅读非常重要，因为我童年最早的记忆都与书有关。没有哪个夜晚我不记得妈妈在床边给我读故事书。那些文字优雅的读音极大地启发了我。

ex.s: Try to note down how it sounds and keep listening.
ex.t: 试着记下它的发音，并继续听。

ex.s: More than 30 years ago, the scholar Charles Hockett noted that speech sounds called labiodentals, such as “f” and “v”, were more common in the languages of societies that ate softer foods.
ex.t: 30多年前，学者查尔斯·霍克特(Charles Hockett)指出，在食用软食的社会语言中，称为labiodentals的语音，如“f”和“v”更为常见。

ex.s: This research overturns the popular view that all human speech sounds were present when human beings evolved around 300,000 years ago. ”The set of speech sounds we use has not necessarily remained stable since the appearance of human beings, but rather the huge variety of speech sounds that we find today is the product of a complex interplay of things like biological change and cultural evolution,“ said Steven Moran, a member of the research team.
ex.t: 这项研究推翻了“人类约30万年前进化时所有语音都已存在”的流行观点。“我们使用的语音集合自人类出现以来未必保持稳定，我们今天发现的极其多样的语音，是生物变化和文化演变等事物复杂相互作用的产物，”研究团队成员史蒂文·莫兰说。

ex.s: What does Steven Moran say about the set of human speech sounds?
ex.t: Steven Moran对人类语音集合有什么看法？

ex.s: Which aspect of the human speech sound does Damián Blasi’s research focus on?
ex.t: Damián Blasi的研究聚焦于人类语音的哪个方面？

ex.s: It's a joy for him to see the kids get excited when they learn to sound out words.
ex.t: 最重要的是，故事具有变革的力量，让我们能够以一种不同于独自面对世界的方式来看待这个世界。

defs.def: to measure the depth of the sea or a lake by using a line with a weight attached, or an electronic instrument 测（海或湖的）深度
sensible; that you can rely on and that will probably give good results 明智的；合理的；正确的；可靠的

ex.s: Interviewer: That's sound advice for sure.
ex.t: 采访者：那绝对是靠谱的建议。

defs.def: good and thorough 透彻的；完备的；全面的
in good condition; not damaged, hurt, etc. 完好的；健康的；无损伤的；未受伤的

ex.s: Beautiful year-round, they invite you to enjoy the smallest detail, from the sound of grasses in the gentle wind to the sculpture of odd-looking seed heads.
ex.t: 它们全年都很美丽，邀请你欣赏最小的细节，从微风中草的沙沙声到造型奇特的种头的雕塑般美感。

defs.def: deep and peaceful 酣畅的；香甜的
good and accurate, but not excellent 不错的；实实在在的
